name: gp-all-proximity
positions_description: SGP4 from CelesTrak GP/OMM, TEME rotated with GMST to approximate Earth-fixed axes
limitations: GP catalog membership does not establish operational service or ISL capability.
Catalog bands are 0.2-degree inclination and 5-km mean-altitude display bins, not official shells.
RAAN groups use a 0.6-degree gap tolerance; plane/slot labels are inferred.
All ISLs are modeled with a uniform assumed terminal budget, not observed Starlink connectivity.
Links meet range and Earth-clearance at the exported sample times only; not continuous validation.
No inter-band links unless inter_shell_links is explicitly enabled.
Earth-fixed transform neglects polar motion and precession/nutation corrections.
